DONALD JAMES LITTLE Don passed away on July 4, 2007, at the age of 87 at the Concordia Hospital. He leaves to mourn his wife of 36 years Pauline, his daughter Bonnie (Gerry) Wraight, his stepchildren Gerry (Anita) Fingler, Norm (Debbie) Fingler, Al (Shirley) Fingler, Ken Fingler, Glenn Fingler, Cindy (Mike) Mencik, numerous grandchildren and great-grandchildren. Don was predeceased by his parents and his son James. Don spent much of his early life as a salesman on the road. He was always very involved with volunteer work with St. John's Ambulance and continued his activities after retirement with Square Dance Club, Crime Stoppers, Rock of Ages Lapidary Club and the Grace Senior club. Don loved to meet people and was always anxious to shake your hand and tell you a joke. Cremation has taken place. A memorial service will be held at 11:00 a.m. on Wednesday, July 25 at Grace Lutheran Church, 211 Kimberley Avenue, Winnipeg. In lieu of flowers, donations may be made to Grace Lutheran Church.

As published in Winnipeg Free Press on Jul 21, 2007
